commonsFile: File:Mountain road at Mã Pí Lèng Pass, Hà Giang Province, Vietnam.jpg
location: Mã Pí Lèng pass, between Mèo Vạc and Đồng Văn
alt: The road cut along the cliffs of Mã Pí Lèng pass above the Nho Quế gorge in Hà Giang
caption: The road cut into the cliffs of Mã Pí Lèng pass, high above the Nho Quế gorge. Day 7 stops at its viewpoints after the Mèo Vạc market, with a driver at the wheel instead of a rented motorbike.

commonsFile: File:Cao nguyên đá Đồng Văn - NKS.jpg
location: Đồng Văn Karst Plateau, Hà Giang
alt: Grey limestone ridges and fields on the Đồng Văn Karst Plateau
caption: Grey limestone ridges and stone-walled fields on the Đồng Văn Karst Plateau, a UNESCO Global Geopark. Days 7 and 8 cross this plateau between Mèo Vạc, Đồng Văn and the Lũng Cú border hills.

commonsFile: File:Ban Gioc Waterfall - Trung Kanh District - Cao Bang Province - Vietnam - 11 (48119809353).jpg
location: Bản Giốc waterfall, Trùng Khánh, Cao Bằng
alt: The multi-tiered Bản Giốc waterfall on the Vietnam–China border
caption: The tiered Bản Giốc waterfall on the Quây Sơn river, which forms the border with China. Day 5 visits it by bamboo raft from a Tày stilt-house base at Khuổi Ky.

location: Ba Bể lake, Ba Bể National Park
alt: Ba Bể lake surrounded by forested limestone hills
caption: Ba Bể, Vietnam's largest natural freshwater lake, ringed by forested limestone hills. Day 3 takes an afternoon boat past Puông cave and Đầu Đẳng waterfall, then sleeps in a Tày stilt house at Pác Ngòi.

location: Lũng Cú flag tower, Đồng Văn district
alt: The Lũng Cú flag tower on a hilltop near the Chinese border
caption: The flag tower on the hill at Lũng Cú, at Vietnam's northern tip beside the Chinese frontier. Day 8 drives up from Đồng Văn before a night with a Lô Lô host family in the village below.

alt: Stalls and shoppers at the Sunday market in Mèo Vạc
caption: Stalls and shoppers at the Sunday market in Mèo Vạc, where Hmong and neighbouring groups trade from the surrounding mountains. Day 7 is timed to arrive by about 9 a.m. when it is busiest.

location: Quản Bạ Heaven's Gate road, Hà Giang
alt: The road climbing to Heaven's Gate pass at Quản Bạ
caption: The switchback road climbing to Heaven's Gate pass above Quản Bạ. Day 10 stops here and at the Twin Mountains viewpoint on the last stretch down to Hà Giang city.

alt: Street vendors on a Hanoi street selling food and goods
caption: Street vendors in Hanoi's Old Quarter, the starting point of the food walk on day 2 (bún chả, phở, bánh cuốn, egg coffee). The group returns here on day 11 before the flight home.

commonsFile: File:Nguom Ngao Cave - Cao Bang Province - Vietnam - 01 (48119822398).jpg
location: Nguồm Ngao cave, Trùng Khánh, Cao Bằng
alt: Limestone formations inside Nguồm Ngao cave in Cao Bằng province
caption: Limestone formations in Nguồm Ngao cave, a few kilometres from Bản Giốc waterfall. Day 5 pairs the two in a single day before the night at a Tày stilt house in Khuổi Ky.

location: Nho Quế river, below Mã Pí Lèng pass
alt: The green Nho Quế river winding through the deep gorge below Mã Pí Lèng pass
caption: The Nho Quế river at the bottom of its gorge, far below Mã Pí Lèng pass. On day 7 the group walks down to the water and takes a short boat trip along it.

location: Lô Lô Chải village, Lũng Cú, Đồng Văn district
alt: Stone and earth houses of Lô Lô Chải village below the hills at Lũng Cú
caption: The houses of Lô Lô Chải, a Lô Lô village in the hills below Lũng Cú. Day 8 stays with a host family here for dinner and the night, the trip's closest look at a minority community's daily life.

commonsFile: File:Sa Phin palais hmong cour int.jpg
location: Hmong king's palace, Sà Phìn, Đồng Văn district
alt: Inner courtyard of the Hmong king's palace at Sà Phìn
caption: An inner courtyard of the Hmong king's palace at Sà Phìn, a fortified early-20th-century mansion of the Vương family. Day 9 stops here between Lô Lô Chải and the Du Già valley.
